name: Honey Chipotle Chicken Burrito
writer_notes: TIKTOK source (same creator as C12): macros rebuilt from ingredients against the food DB, not the caption.
CAP: rice cut from 100 g to 50 g cooked per burrito (17.9 g dry x 14 = 250 g dry).
Source called it chipotle paste; resolved to Chipotle in Adobo blended smooth (same product). Board id chipotle-adobo exists.
Fat Free Cottage Cheese is a stub row in ingredients.json (no bid/packaging): not cost-tracked. Flagged.
intro_html: Sweet heat that behaves itself. Honey and chipotle usually ride on a pile of sugar and oil, but this build lands at {{cal}} calories with {{protein}} grams of protein, on a tortilla carrying 18 grams of fiber for about 5 grams of net carb. The sauce is blended cottage cheese loosened with hot sauce, honey, and smoky chipotle, so it clings to the chicken like a glaze without a real glaze's calories. It is the kind of flavor you expect to pay for and do not.
ingredients_display: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast (Member's Mark): 3.5 lb (1582 g)
Fat Free Cottage Cheese (Great Value): 3 cups (700 g)
Chipotle in Adobo (La Costena): 2 chiles, blended (14 g)
cost_note_html: Real Omaha store prices from our weekly grocery board (2026). They still swing by store and by what is on sale.
cost_lines: Boneless Skinless Chicken Breast, 3.5 lb: ~$7.78. Buy 4 lbs: $8.92.
Fat Free Cottage Cheese, 3 cups: ~$2.81. Buy 2 24oz tubs: $5.46.
Buffalo Wing Sauce, 7.5 tbsp: ~$0.77. Buy 1 (lasts several batches).
Pantry seasonings (chipotle in adobo, ground cumin, garlic powder): ~$0.29. From jars you keep on hand.

Batch total: about $24.82 across 14 servings, so roughly $1.77 per burrito. This counts only the amounts this batch actually uses from each package, so it is the cost of the food in the containers, not a register receipt.

True shopping cost: about $31.65 across 14 servings, roughly $2.26 per burrito. What the register trip looks like if your pantry is already stocked. Meat, produce, and packaged items are counted as the whole packages you have to buy, since you cannot grab a partial box, can, or jar. Pantry staples you already own (rice, seasonings, oils, and long-lasting sauces) are counted at only what this batch uses.

Starting with an empty pantry? Add about $8.01 one time. That is the extra cost of buying full containers of every pantry staple in this recipe instead of just the amounts used, which puts a first shopping trip near $39.66. Those containers then feed this batch and many more after it.
cost_closing_html: That is about ${{cost_ps}} a burrito (at everyday cost) versus $10 or more for a honey chipotle chicken bowl out. The chicken is the cost. The flavor is nearly free.
shop_smart: One can of chipotle in adobo lasts months. You only blend a couple of chiles per batch, so freeze the rest in a spoon-sized ice cube tray and pull one out next time. Do not buy a fresh can every cook.
Honey is the whole sweet side, so a little is plenty. A few tablespoons across 14 burritos is all it takes, and one bottle outlasts the season.
Cottage cheese blended smooth is the sauce base. It turns a sugary glaze into a high-protein one, and the big tub costs less per ounce than the small one.
make_it: Weigh your empty mixing pot and write the number down for portioning later.
Cook 1.25 cups of dry rice per the package and set it aside.
Cube the chicken breast and cook it in a dry or lightly sprayed skillet over medium-high heat until it reaches 165F inside.
Make the honey chipotle sauce: blend the fat free cottage cheese, buffalo wing sauce, the chipotle in adobo, honey, ground cumin, garlic powder, and lime juice until smooth.
Turn the heat low and fold the sauce and the reduced fat mozzarella into the chicken so the cheese melts and the glaze coats every piece.
Stir the rice into the saucy chicken.
Warm the tortillas so they roll cleanly, then fill and wrap each one.
portion_html: Set the full pot on your scale and subtract the empty-pot weight from Step 1. Divide that total food weight by 14 and scoop the same amount into each tortilla. Every burrito lands near {{cal}} calories with {{protein}} grams of protein.

Fat Free Cottage Cheese, 3 cups (700 g)
Chipotle in Adobo, 2 chiles, blended (14 g)
steps: Cook 1.25 cups dry rice per the package.
Cube and cook the chicken breast until it reaches 165F.
Blend the fat free cottage cheese, buffalo wing sauce, chipotle in adobo, honey, cumin, garlic powder, and lime juice into a smooth sauce.
Fold the sauce and mozzarella into the warm chicken, then stir in the rice.
Weigh the batch and divide into 14 equal burritos.
